mintAuthority.summary: The live Ethereum FactTokenDiamond delegates mint(bytes32,address,uint256) to a verified Tokenization Agent-gated MintableFacet. The request identifier is an operational idempotence control, not an on-chain collateral cap. The diamond owner contract can replace mint logic immediately; beneficial controller quorum and complete live Tokenization Agent membership were not resolved.

controls.label: FactTokenDiamond Tokenization Agent mint surface
controls.evidence: Pinned loupe call binds the mint selector to0xe70c597957e542209ed44f2fbae58370089e59be. Mint requires TOKENIZATION_AGENT, active token, active requester and not-paused state. Owner-only DiamondCutFacet can replace the delegatecalled mint facet; the verified code has no timelock on that call. Role members, controller signing quorum, key custody and an enforceable aggregate collateral ceiling remain unresolved.

controls.label: FactTokenDiamond owner controller
controls.evidence: Pinned owner() returned this contract at Ethereum block26107698 (0x18e5f32), blockHash0x1873f19af6d4b1423d634e2067220be47f24b4aed3efab69b062aac2a5b0a9fd. facetAddress(0x1f931c1c) binds DiamondCutFacet0x6e4d1a8b0a6b2ed26c50873c2c75feac77385295; verified diamondCut calls enforceIsContractOwner and allows add/replace/remove/delegatecall with no local delay. The owner is itself a contract, not an asserted EOA/multisig. No claim that the controller's own ownership/upgrade path is immutable or independently timelocked. Pinned eth_getCode proves the controller is a contract. No multisig threshold or signer count was established.

sources.label: SEC-filed JLTXX prospectus, Investor Register and daily reconciliation

review.evidence: The legal Investor Register governs ownership and is reconciled daily to tokenized share balances. This is disclosed internal-ledger reconciliation, not independent reserve coverage or prudential mint supervision. Scoreable under the approved Ethereum single-deployment roster, which reconciles to published Token Class assets to about0.0116%; the October1 Solana authorization is an unresolved expansion signal, not an invented deployment/control.
